text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf has been training<n>harder than ever
in the run-up to the<n>spring Tenno Sho, adjusting
her<n>focus to account for the unique<n>demands of
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But now that she's a senior and<n>making a name
for herself in the<n>racing world, the demands on her
time are multiplying.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
So, to wrap things up, could you tell<n>us what your
plans are for the future?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I mean to recommit myself to training,<n>with the
goal of becoming the<n>Emperor of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I hope that you continue to cover<n>every step of my
imperial campaign.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I promise to exceed all of your<n>expectations.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You sound as confident as ever! I'll<n>be rooting for
you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Next is my TV interview, I believe...<n>Hmmm. My
schedule's been packed<n>a little too tight, perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As a rising star, Symboli Rudolf is<n>constantly
swamped with interviews.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She takes it all in stride, saying that<n>it's proof of
the stir she's causing in<n>the racing world, but I'm
a bit more<n>worried...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Shall we head to the track? This<n>interview
presents a golden<n>opportunity for the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Perfect for the announcement I have<n>planned.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha. You can cock your head at me<n>all you like,
but I'm not telling. You'll<n>just have to wait and
see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And that concludes our tour of the<n>academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We host guided visits periodically, so<n>please apply
if you're interested.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That's fascinating... but is there any<n>other way to
get a feel for the<n>academy aside from guided
tours?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed there is—and what's more, it<n>will be held in
only a few days' time.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text: How interesting! Can you tell us<n>more?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's called the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Every spring, Tracen Academy hosts<n>a large
event complete with races and<n>more. It's intended
to help our<n>students interact with the fans who
support them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This year, we plan to expand its<n>scope and create
our first "Mega"<n>Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You don't say! How are you going to<n>make it
bigger?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We plan to offer additional races,<n>volunteer
presentations, live panels<n>with academy
graduates...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And a wide variety of other new<n>activities for
visitors to enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It will be accessible for both racing<n>fans and
newcomers alike.

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
That sounds marvelous! Do you have<n>any plans to
take part in the event<n>yourself?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will spend most of the Fan Fest<n>patrolling the
grounds in my capacity<n>as student council
president...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
But to close out the day, I will take<n>part in the main
attraction: the<n>exhibition race.
choice_data_list: (Huh?! She never told me about that!)

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Holy moly! So we'll get to see you<n>race in
person? How incredibly<n>exciting!

text_block_list.name: TV Reporter
text_block_list.text:
You hear that, everyone? Make sure<n>to check out
Tracen Academy's Fan<n>Fest!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're guaranteed to have a<n>fan-fest-ic time.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Be sure not to miss this opportunity to<n>watch our
very own Umamusume<n>compete live on the track.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Phew. That's the last of them for<n>today.
choice_data_list: What's this about the exhibition race?
What's this about the exhibition race?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I've been planning it for a while, but I<n>only
received the official approval a<n>few days ago.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the name implies, I hope to make it<n>the Fan
Fest's main attraction.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Accordingly, I have scheduled it as<n>the finale of
the event, and gathered<n>all of the school's best
racers to take<n>part.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The Emperor's presence on the track<n>will only
raise its profile further.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I can personally contribute to the<n>Fan Fest's
success, then so much<n>the better.
choice_data_list: You should have told me sooner.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Exhibition or not, a race is a race. I<n>would have
appreciated the<n>opportunity to adjust her training
regimen so that she could give her<n>best
performance, and I tell her as<n>much.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the sentiment, but I've<n>already
factored in our current<n>schedule.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No adjustments will be required.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But that will still place a heavy burden<n>on her. As
her trainer, it's something I<n>can't ignore.
choice_data_list: You need to rely on me more.
You need to rely on me more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your concern, Trainer.<n>Truly, I do.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But by the same token, I ask the<n>same from you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Please, have a little more faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No... Perhaps that's the wrong way of<n>thinking
about it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I were truly worth believing in, I<n>wouldn't have
to convince you at all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That, I believe, is what Air Groove<n>was trying to
tell me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You've got it all wrong, President. You<n>don't...
understand at all...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I must be more selfless. Push myself<n>harder.
Make greater sacrifices.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Who will follow the Emperor if she<n>doesn't show
that she can lead?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
My ideal is still a distant dream. I<n>must seek out
more victories and<n>greater prestige.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From the way she's speaking, she<n>should sound
grand, but instead she<n>just looks... like she's
drowning.
choice_data_list: Have you spoken with Air Groove?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Not yet. Preparing for the Fan Fest<n>has been
keeping her too busy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Besides, she has already thrown<n>down the
gauntlet, and I've found my<n>answer to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I will put on such a convincing<n>performance at the
exhibition race<n>that none will be able to doubt me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Failure is a luxury I can't afford on<n>such a grand
stage.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
A mediocre performance will<n>undermine the impact
I've made on<n>the racing world, and I cannot allow
that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Every word lands like another weight<n>on her back.
It almost hurts to watch...

text_block_list.name: Student Council Member
text_block_list.text:
There you are, President! There are a<n>few things I
wanted to confirm with<n>you about the Fan Fest...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'll be right there.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: My apologies, Trainer, but duty calls.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She departs, leaving me wondering<n>once more if
there's anything I can<n>do to help her.
